findings: No application API key/authentication header or embedded provider secret found.
Application requests are HTTPS public Open-Meteo endpoints; city coordinates are configured public cities.
No application source deletes files or directories. Existing build automation creates output and builds only the main scene. Packaging stages copies and never deletes source/build data.
Weather requests time out after 20 seconds; retry delay is bounded to 15..300 seconds with one active coroutine/request; cancellation and cleanup passed runtime tests.
Strict parser rejects malformed/oversized/deep responses. Missing inputs remain nullable and pause live integration.
Release Pipeline is disabled; no runtime control listener is configured.
Logs reviewed contain system/device diagnostics and weather/status, without credentials.
scope: Targeted credential pattern scan plus manual review of all application sources, build/dependency automation and request logging; not a comprehensive security audit
limitations: Dependency binaries and all possible credential formats were not exhaustively audited.
